## Hypothesis

The overnight_grinder sweep identified a parameter combination that significantly increases wide_pnl by capturing the 5/04 winner while avoiding losses on J loser days. The edge_capture of 670.6 suggests the strategy captures partial upside on winner days without adding downside on loser days, but remains below the OP-16 floor of 771 due to missing two winner days (4/29, 5/01). The extreme concentration (top5_pct=106.7%) indicates reliance on a few large wins.

## Mechanism

The combo modifies exit parameters: super_stop=-0.15 (15% stop), super_tp1=0.75 (75% TP1), runner_target=3.0 (300% runner target), level_qty=18 contracts, level_stop=-0.12, level_tp1=0.3, trendline_stop=-0.06. Compared to baseline (unknown), this appears to tighten super exits while widening level exits and increasing position sizing for level setups. The strategy triggers on 5/04 (capturing $670.6 vs. available $730) and two 5/07 loser-day reversals (each +$74.29), while skipping 4/29, 5/01, 5/05, and 5/06.
